name: Julia Letlow

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EMERGENCY CONSERVATION PROGRAM IMPROVEMENT ACT OF 2025
statements.title: EMERGENCY CONSERVATION PROGRAM IMPROVEMENT ACT OF 2025
sentences: It includes restoring farmland, rehabilitating conservation structures, and stabilizing land after devastating events.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 1011, the Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this practical, bipartisan solution and stand with the farmers, ranchers, forest landowners, and family forestry businesses who feed, fuel, and sustain our Nation.
